sources.entry: Night Shift Control - Night Shift Control is a simple macOS menubar app for controlling Night Shift. It's aim is to bring features from f.lux which are missing from Night Shift such as disabling Night Shift for certain apps.

summary.one_liner: Night Shift Control is a small macOS menubar app that controls Night Shift and adds f.lux-style features such as disabling Night Shift for chosen apps.
use_cases: Turn Night Shift on or off quickly from the menu bar
Keep Night Shift off for specific apps such as color-sensitive work
Adjust Night Shift warmth without opening System Settings
Check current Night Shift status and color temperature
Replace f.lux-style per-app behavior on a Mac
how_to_run: Download the zip file from the Download link in the README
Run sudo spctl --master-disable to temporarily disable Gatekeeper
Unzip the file and drag the app to the Applications folder
Re-enable Gatekeeper afterward via System Preferences -> Security and Privacy -> General
Optionally add the app to Login Items to launch at login
To build from source, copy CoreBrightness.framework to a user-owned folder and add it to Framework Search Paths in Xcode
notable: Disables Night Shift for apps you choose, a feature Apple's Night Shift lacks
Menubar controls for on/off and warmth
Option-click the menubar icon to view status and color temperature info
Built around a private macOS framework rather than public APIs
caveats: The app is not officially signed, so Gatekeeper must be disabled temporarily to install it
Depends on the private CoreBrightness.framework, and building it needed a workaround the author describes
